Product Details: Turn your Dremel rotary tool into a powerful cutting machine with the Dremel EZ Lock™ Starter Kit. The EZ406-02 includes the EZ402 mandrel and five EZ456 Fiberglass Reinforced Cut-Off Wheels, creating a versatile cutoff wheel set and rotary tool accessory kit for DIYers, makers, and repair professionals. Engineered to last up to 2X longer than the Dremel 426 cut-off wheel, these highly durable, fiberglass-reinforced cut-off wheels are designed for demanding cutting applications. Featuring a 1-1/2 in. (38.1 mm) wheel diameter and a 0.045 in. (1.1 mm) thickness, they are ideal for cutting, trimming, and grooving a variety of metals, including hardened steel. Perfect for tasks such as cutting bolt heads, reslotting damaged screws, trimming metal rods, and cutting sheet metal, these cutting discs also provide excellent performance on delicate woodworking projects and can be used on materials such as wood, plastic, and ceramics. Compatible with Dremel rotary tools using the EZ Lock system, this cutting wheel kit and EZ Lock accessory set delivers exceptional versatility and convenience. The patented EZ Lock™ system enables fast, secure, and tool-free accessory changes, helping you spend less time switching accessories and more time completing your projects.
